title: Quantifying the Spread of Online Incivility in Brazilian Politics
findings: Self-identified religious individuals supporting the right-wing candidate (Bolsonaro) were a notable group among disseminators of uncivil content, particularly in the categories of Hate Speech and Stereotyping (HSST) and Threats to Democratic Institutions and Values (THREAT).
